name: Self-hosted adoption
description: Reporting installations, registered and active accounts, workflow use, and observed retention. Counts cover reporting installations and keep incomplete observation windows separate.

insights.name: Accounts across reporting installations
insights.description: Latest reports within seven days. Active-account totals include only installations with complete observation windows.

source.query:
WITH snapshots AS (SELECT distinct_id, timestamp, toInt(properties.schema) AS schema,
    coalesce(toInt(properties.reportDay), -1) AS report_day,
    coalesce(toInt(properties.activitySinceDay), -1) AS since_day,
    coalesce(toInt(properties.activationDay), -1) AS activation_day,
    coalesce(toInt(properties.totalAccounts), -1) AS accounts,
    coalesce(toInt(properties.activeAccounts1d), -1) AS daily,
    coalesce(toInt(properties.activeAccounts7d), -1) AS weekly,
    coalesce(toInt(properties.activeAccounts30d), -1) AS monthly,
    coalesce(toInt(properties.creates7d), -1) AS creates,
    coalesce(toInt(properties.edits7d), -1) AS edits,
    coalesce(toInt(properties.reads7d), -1) AS reads,
    coalesce(toInt(properties.workflow7d.web), -1) AS web,
    coalesce(toInt(properties.workflow7d.api), -1) AS api,
    coalesce(toInt(properties.workflow7d.cli), -1) AS cli,
    coalesce(toInt(properties.workflow7d.mcp), -1) AS mcp
  FROM events WHERE event = 'self_hosted_instance_report' AND timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 120 DAY), latest AS (SELECT distinct_id, argMax(report_day, timestamp) AS report_day, argMax(since_day, timestamp) AS since_day, argMax(activation_day, timestamp) AS activation_day, argMax(accounts, timestamp) AS accounts, argMax(daily, timestamp) AS daily, argMax(weekly, timestamp) AS weekly, argMax(monthly, timestamp) AS monthly, argMax(creates, timestamp) AS creates, argMax(edits, timestamp) AS edits, argMax(reads, timestamp) AS reads, argMax(web, timestamp) AS web, argMax(api, timestamp) AS api, argMax(cli, timestamp) AS cli, argMax(mcp, timestamp) AS mcp FROM snapshots WHERE schema = 2 AND timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY GROUP BY distinct_id)
SELECT (SELECT count(DISTINCT distinct_id) FROM snapshots WHERE timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY) AS reporting_installations,
 count() AS installations_with_account_counts,
 if(count() = 0, NULL, sum(accounts)) AS registered_accounts,
 countIf(report_day - 6 > since_day) AS installations_with_full_week,
 if(countIf(report_day - 6 > since_day) = 0, NULL, sumIf(weekly, report_day - 6 > since_day)) AS weekly_active_accounts,
 countIf(report_day - 29 > since_day) AS installations_with_full_month,
 if(countIf(report_day - 29 > since_day) = 0, NULL, sumIf(monthly, report_day - 29 > since_day)) AS monthly_active_accounts
 FROM latest

source.query:
WITH snapshots AS (SELECT distinct_id, timestamp, toInt(properties.schema) AS schema,
    coalesce(toInt(properties.reportDay), -1) AS report_day,
    coalesce(toInt(properties.activitySinceDay), -1) AS since_day,
    coalesce(toInt(properties.activationDay), -1) AS activation_day,
    coalesce(toInt(properties.totalAccounts), -1) AS accounts,
    coalesce(toInt(properties.activeAccounts1d), -1) AS daily,
    coalesce(toInt(properties.activeAccounts7d), -1) AS weekly,
    coalesce(toInt(properties.activeAccounts30d), -1) AS monthly,
    coalesce(toInt(properties.creates7d), -1) AS creates,
    coalesce(toInt(properties.edits7d), -1) AS edits,
    coalesce(toInt(properties.reads7d), -1) AS reads,
    coalesce(toInt(properties.workflow7d.web), -1) AS web,
    coalesce(toInt(properties.workflow7d.api), -1) AS api,
    coalesce(toInt(properties.workflow7d.cli), -1) AS cli,
    coalesce(toInt(properties.workflow7d.mcp), -1) AS mcp
  FROM events WHERE event = 'self_hosted_instance_report' AND timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 120 DAY), latest AS (SELECT distinct_id, argMax(report_day, timestamp) AS report_day, argMax(since_day, timestamp) AS since_day, argMax(activation_day, timestamp) AS activation_day, argMax(accounts, timestamp) AS accounts, argMax(daily, timestamp) AS daily, argMax(weekly, timestamp) AS weekly, argMax(monthly, timestamp) AS monthly, argMax(creates, timestamp) AS creates, argMax(edits, timestamp) AS edits, argMax(reads, timestamp) AS reads, argMax(web, timestamp) AS web, argMax(api, timestamp) AS api, argMax(cli, timestamp) AS cli, argMax(mcp, timestamp) AS mcp FROM snapshots WHERE schema = 2 AND timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY GROUP BY distinct_id)
, daily_reports AS (SELECT distinct_id, toStartOfDay(timestamp) AS date,
 argMax(schema, timestamp) AS schema, argMax(daily, timestamp) AS daily,
 argMax(report_day, timestamp) AS report_day, argMax(since_day, timestamp) AS since_day
 FROM snapshots WHERE timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY GROUP BY distinct_id, date)
 SELECT date, count() AS reporting_installations,
 countIf(schema = 2 AND daily > 0 AND report_day > since_day) AS installations_with_activity
 FROM daily_reports GROUP BY date ORDER BY date

insights.description: Actions from complete seven-day windows, using one latest report per installation.

    coalesce(toInt(properties.reportDay), -1) AS report_day,

    coalesce(toInt(properties.activeAccounts30d), -1) AS monthly,
    coalesce(toInt(properties.creates7d), -1) AS creates,
    coalesce(toInt(properties.edits7d), -1) AS edits,
    coalesce(toInt(properties.reads7d), -1) AS reads,
    coalesce(toInt(properties.workflow7d.web), -1) AS web,
    coalesce(toInt(properties.workflow7d.api), -1) AS api,
    coalesce(toInt(properties.workflow7d.cli), -1) AS cli,
    coalesce(toInt(properties.workflow7d.mcp), -1) AS mcp
  FROM events WHERE event = 'self_hosted_instance_report' AND timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 120 DAY), latest AS (SELECT distinct_id, argMax(report_day, timestamp) AS report_day, argMax(since_day, timestamp) AS since_day, argMax(activation_day, timestamp) AS activation_day, argMax(accounts, timestamp) AS accounts, argMax(daily, timestamp) AS daily, argMax(weekly, timestamp) AS weekly, argMax(monthly, timestamp) AS monthly, argMax(creates, timestamp) AS creates, argMax(edits, timestamp) AS edits, argMax(reads, timestamp) AS reads, argMax(web, timestamp) AS web, argMax(api, timestamp) AS api, argMax(cli, timestamp) AS cli, argMax(mcp, timestamp) AS mcp FROM snapshots WHERE schema = 2 AND timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY GROUP BY distinct_id)
SELECT 'Web' AS workflow, if(countIf(report_day - 6 > since_day) = 0, NULL, sumIf(web, report_day - 6 > since_day)) AS actions FROM latest
UNION ALL
SELECT 'CLI' AS workflow, if(countIf(report_day - 6 > since_day) = 0, NULL, sumIf(cli, report_day - 6 > since_day)) AS actions FROM latest
UNION ALL
SELECT 'MCP' AS workflow, if(countIf(report_day - 6 > since_day) = 0, NULL, sumIf(mcp, report_day - 6 > since_day)) AS actions FROM latest
UNION ALL
SELECT 'API and extensions' AS workflow, if(countIf(report_day - 6 > since_day) = 0, NULL, sumIf(api, report_day - 6 > since_day)) AS actions FROM latest

insights.name: Observed installation retention
insights.description: Week-1 and week-4 returns after first paste. Missing observation is unknown; rates exclude unknown windows.

source.query:
WITH snapshots AS (SELECT distinct_id, timestamp, toInt(properties.schema) AS schema,
    coalesce(toInt(properties.reportDay), -1) AS report_day,
    coalesce(toInt(properties.activitySinceDay), -1) AS since_day,
    coalesce(toInt(properties.activationDay), -1) AS activation_day,
    coalesce(toInt(properties.totalAccounts), -1) AS accounts,
    coalesce(toInt(properties.activeAccounts1d), -1) AS daily,
    coalesce(toInt(properties.activeAccounts7d), -1) AS weekly,
    coalesce(toInt(properties.activeAccounts30d), -1) AS monthly,
    coalesce(toInt(properties.creates7d), -1) AS creates,
    coalesce(toInt(properties.edits7d), -1) AS edits,
    coalesce(toInt(properties.reads7d), -1) AS reads,
    coalesce(toInt(properties.workflow7d.web), -1) AS web,
    coalesce(toInt(properties.workflow7d.api), -1) AS api,
    coalesce(toInt(properties.workflow7d.cli), -1) AS cli,
    coalesce(toInt(properties.workflow7d.mcp), -1) AS mcp
  FROM events WHERE event = 'self_hosted_instance_report' AND timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 120 DAY),
 days AS (SELECT distinct_id, report_day, argMax(activation_day, timestamp) AS activation_day,
 argMax(since_day, timestamp) AS since_day, argMax(daily, timestamp) AS daily
 FROM snapshots WHERE schema = 2 GROUP BY distinct_id, report_day),
 cohorts AS (SELECT distinct_id, max(report_day) AS last_day, max(activation_day) AS first_activation_day,
 uniqExactIf(report_day, report_day BETWEEN activation_day + 7 AND activation_day + 13 AND since_day <= activation_day) AS week1_days,
 max(if(report_day BETWEEN activation_day + 7 AND activation_day + 13 AND since_day <= activation_day AND daily > 0, 1, 0)) AS week1_returned,
 uniqExactIf(report_day, report_day BETWEEN activation_day + 28 AND activation_day + 34 AND since_day <= activation_day) AS week4_days,
 max(if(report_day BETWEEN activation_day + 28 AND activation_day + 34 AND since_day <= activation_day AND daily > 0, 1, 0)) AS week4_returned
 FROM days WHERE activation_day >= 0 GROUP BY distinct_id)
 SELECT countIf(last_day >= first_activation_day + 13 AND week1_returned = 1) AS week1_retained,
 countIf(last_day >= first_activation_day + 13 AND (week1_days = 7 OR week1_returned = 1)) AS week1_eligible,
 countIf(last_day >= first_activation_day + 13 AND week1_days < 7 AND week1_returned = 0) AS week1_unknown,
 week1_retained / nullIf(week1_eligible, 0) AS week1_retention,
 countIf(last_day >= first_activation_day + 34 AND week4_returned = 1) AS week4_retained,
 countIf(last_day >= first_activation_day + 34 AND (week4_days = 7 OR week4_returned = 1)) AS week4_eligible,
 countIf(last_day >= first_activation_day + 34 AND week4_days < 7 AND week4_returned = 0) AS week4_unknown,
 week4_retained / nullIf(week4_eligible, 0) AS week4_retention FROM cohorts
